title: vMotion blocked by network mismatch
input: VM migration compatibility reports a network label mismatch. vpxd logged task failed. Contact: Test User test@example.invalid Case SR-000101
infer: configuration mismatch is a hypothesis, not root cause
avoid: changing distributed switch configuration without approval

title: Datastore latency alert
input: vmkernel reports storage latency warning on a synthetic datastore; VMs remain online.
infer: storage path or array pressure remains hypothetical
avoid: rescan or path changes during production without approval

title: Host management disconnect
input: hostd timeout followed by vpxd host unavailable; management VM traffic status unknown.

title: VCSA disk capacity warning
input: applmgmt reports filesystem capacity warning. Service state remains green.
infer: partition growth source must be identified
avoid: deleting database or log files manually

title: SSO login failures
input: SSO authentication failed for synthetic users; vmdird and vmafdd are present in correlated logs.
infer: identity, time, DNS, or certificate dependency
request: identity source scope and certificate status
avoid: resetting identity or replacing certificates prematurely

title: VCF 9 vCenter upgrade precheck sizing
input: Brownfield import reports VCENTER UPGRADE PRECHECK failure and cannot determine appliance size. Current VCSA allocation is unusually large.
infer: nonstandard sizing may block automatic mapping
request: VCSA deployment size and supported upgrade path
avoid: changing appliance memory merely to bypass precheck

title: VCF stretched-domain inventory drift
input: Lifecycle upgrade cannot move target vCenter to primary AZ. Inventory shows fewer hosts than expected after a prior remove and re-add.
infer: SDDC Manager and vCenter inventory drift
avoid: manual database edits or forced upgrade continuation

title: VCF 9 lifecycle image transition
input: An ESX 8 cluster uses baseline lifecycle management and VCF 9 upgrade planning reports eligibility concerns. vLCM image is not defined.
request: hardware compatibility, vendor add-on, firmware and target image
avoid: converting lifecycle mode or remediating all hosts without validated compatibility and rollback

title: vCenter 9 centralized licensing dependency
input: After upgrade, vCenter remains in evaluation mode and no license assignment succeeds. Management-service association is not documented.
infer: VCF Operations association/licensing architecture may be incomplete
request: VCF Operations association and site connectivity
avoid: reinstalling vCenter or applying unrelated license keys

title: Supervisor workload-domain upgrade sequencing
input: Management domain upgrade succeeded. Workload domain with WCP fails after NSX stage while preparing the vCenter stage.
infer: Supervisor-specific sequencing or known upgrade condition
request: WCP state, precheck output, NSX and lifecycle logs
avoid: disabling Supervisor or skipping lifecycle stages without official procedure
